scientific_integrity: Global conclusions use comparison, invariant subspaces and Taylor estimates, not simulation. Numerical checks are supplementary. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Finite two-community, symmetric, nonnegative structural mixing, zero external bias and positive cross-community coupling; does not cover heterogeneous, noisy or signed interactions; broader literature could subsume components.
title: Global neutral attraction and the exact critical relaxation amplitude in a two-group cultural polarization model
